newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX up, within day earlier range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX up, within day earlier range.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures for October traded higher on Friday, spurred by a firm NYMEX market and the increased tensions surrounding Iraq.
October Brent futures, which expire later on Friday in London, were last traded at $24.12 per barrel, up 25 cents from London's Thursday settlement of $23.87.
Brokers said SIMEX did not trade for most of the day but the firmer tone was attributed to a higher NYMEX crude market.
October on ACCESS last traded at $25.15 per barrel, down from the intraday high of $25.25 but up from the New York close of $25.00.
October traded within New York's trading range of $24.26 to $25.30.
A broker said there was still room on the upside on the Iraq tension, but said traders mnight be more relaxed once the Brent October contract had expired.
The U.S. has been massing ships and warplanes within striking distance of Iraq since Iraq launched a surface-to-air missile against two U.S. jets patrolling the northern no-fly zone.
